subject: general
question: Under which ministry does the National Productivity Council operate?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Commerce and Industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Productivity Council (NPC) operates under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, Government of India.
 
• It is an autonomous organization established in **1958** to promote productivity culture in various sectors of the Indian economy.
 
• NPC is engaged in providing consultancy, training, and research services aimed at enhancing **productivity and competitiveness** of Indian industries.
 
• The council focuses on **sustainable development** and productivity enhancement through innovative strategies and technology adoption.
 
• It is closely associated with the **Asian Productivity Organization (APO)**, a regional intergovernmental organization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Productivity Organization (APO):**

 
 
• It is a regional intergovernmental organization established in **1961** to promote productivity growth in the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• India is a founding member of the APO, and the National Productivity Council serves as its nodal agency in India.
 
• APO focuses on fostering innovation, advancing digital transformation, and promoting green productivity initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of NPC:**
 
 
• Promoting **economic efficiency** and productivity in various sectors.
 
• Encouraging the adoption of **cleaner production practices** for sustainable development.
 
• Providing **capacity-building programs** for industries and government organizations.
 
 
 
• **Key Areas of Focus:**
 
 
• **Energy management** and conservation.
 
• Strengthening **quality management systems**.
 
• Encouraging the adoption of **lean manufacturing practices** to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Productivity Week:**
 
 
• National Productivity Week is observed every year from **12th to 18th February** to raise awareness about productivity and innovation.
 
• The theme of the week is chosen to align with current national priorities and challenges.
